text: Figure 2.1: Functional sketch of the system T ransferred in the AUTOSAR methodology the function is defined by five software com- ponents in one system composition. T wo SensorActuatorSwComponentTypes for the interaction with outer world, one SwComponentType for the internal calculation and two EcuAbstractionSwComponentType for the abstraction of the hardware. The System class is used to describe the System Configuration of the complete AU- TOSAR system. The category property of System shall indicate the role of this work product. Here the category SYSTEM_DESCRIPTION is used. See [TPS_SYST_01003] in [1]. This is typically done by an OEM.
